How it works

1

Invest with Mom’s Touch

After your investment is verified, you can participate in the daily ticket promo.

2

Claim a ticket every day

Visit this page and claim one raffle ticket each day during the promo. Daily claims follow Philippine time.

3

Collect your entries

Each claimed ticket is one raffle entry. Come back daily to collect more chances to win.

4

Join the February 27 draw

All valid entries go into the raffle on February 27, 2027. Claiming tickets gives you a chance to win.
